published_source: Article (Management Science 68(5), 2022, pp. 3813-3833) Table 4, Panel B (Return on assets), column (1): AD Law -0.001 (t = -0.75), Observations 13,472, firm and year FE, SE clustered by firm. published_coef/se keep the authors' code re-run (Accepted_paper_code_to_ms.do, reghdfe on the shipped ad_dataset_ms1.dta; t = -0.750, N 13,472), which equals the print at every printed digit.
replication_status: exact (authors' code re-run equals the printed coefficient, t-statistic and N)
notes: Authors' do-file line 30: reghdfe ni_atw ad_law2 if census_region_south!=. & randsamp1!=., a(cm_id fyear) vce(cluster cm_id). Firm-year panel 1946-1964 (ad_dataset_ms1.dta, 13,633 firm-years in the authors' sample, 1,652 firms, 38 HQ states); unbalanced, most firms enter in 1950 or 1960. Treatment ad_law2 = state fair-employment law in force in the HQ state. gvar g_year is the firm-level adoption year built in build_and_verify.R: the state's observed 0->1 year for the 12 in-sample adopting states (1955 MI MN PA; 1957 CO WI; 1959 CA OH; 1961 IL KS MO; 1963 HI IN), 1945 for the 8 states treated in every observed year (CT MA NJ NM NY OR RI WA; run_spec.R maps this to period 1 = treated from the start), NA for the 18 never-treated states; firms with an observed 0->1 switch keep their own first treated year (one HQ mover IL->NY gets g_year=1960, a single-firm cohort). sample_filter drops the 13 firm-years (3 firms) where ad_law2 reverts to 0 after adoption because of an HQ move out of a treated state (Hull fn 6), so the run_spec.R TWFE differs from the authors' coefficient by this drop only. fixest reproduces the reghdfe coefficient to 1e-11 and the SE to 1e-8 relative once singletons are dropped (verify_twfe_results.csv). No article text in the project: published_coef/published_se are the authors' code re-run on the shipped original data (authors_twfe.do / authors_twfe.log); the article's printed values were not checked.
